## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector breadth (10/11) versus neutral risk ratios (VXX/SPY_TLT/HYG_LQD → flat), while XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND shows tech weakness amid broad strength.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stance HYG/LQD → flat (HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.27%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND) — neutral at the ratio level. Fear slightly firmer: VXX (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -4.47%) RECOVERY (VXX ↑ rising short-term); gold demand steady: GLD (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: SPY/TLT → flat with SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND suggesting slightly higher yields but no clear pivot in conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals leading vs tech: XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND while XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; Style: Value over Growth confirmed by sector breadth.

5. US vs Global?
China/EM strength: FXI (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY; US broad index SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION — regional leadership tilting outside US on 1M.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: IBIT (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +9.70%) CORRECTION shows crypto resilience, ARKK (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND shows thematic weakness, IWM (1W: +0.21% | 1M: -2.01%) RECOVERY.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity strength: CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and PDBC (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND; oil ETFs BNO (1W: -1.22% | 1M: +16.33%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +14.13%) CORRECTION show 1W profit-taking.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy firm: XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND; contrasts with gas weakness: UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: broad sector breadth (10/11) and cyclicals (XLF ABOVE TREND, XLE ABOVE TREND) driving strength. Divergence: tech weakness (XLK BELOW TREND) and QQQ (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND create a MINOR divergence vs the broad advance.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposure (XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to tech momentum (XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND); monitor bonds (TLT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Financials XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND; Energy XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; Thematics ARKK (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and diversified commodities PDBC (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF ratio 2.0 (growth vs value pivot); SPY 1M performance flip (+0.65%) as a short-term confirmation level for risk tone.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, but risk ratios largely neutral so market lacks a clean directional impulse. Cyclicals and commodities showing strength (XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND) while tech (XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND) is the key divergence to monitor.
